text: /* Ensure the grid item itself stretches */ .tile-row { align-items: stretch; /* grid default is stretch, but safe */ } /* Ensure the halves define a real height for children */ .tile-halves { min-height: 300px; width: 100%; display: grid; /* better than flex for overlay cards */ }
html:
/* Ensure the grid item itself stretches */
.tile-row {
  align-items: stretch; /* grid default is stretch, but safe */
}

/* Ensure the halves define a real height for children */
.tile-halves {
  min-height: 300px;
  width: 100%;
  display: grid;         /* better than flex for overlay cards */
}
